[2026-08-22T22:43:04.586Z] [world] You step back into Samarran. The world waits for your move.
[2026-08-22T22:43:04.586Z] [world] The wind has shifted while you were away. The Aetheric haze sits a little thicker on the horizon now.
[2026-08-22T22:43:04.592Z] [arbiter] The Arbiter sets the quiet aside. "Welcome back, Verbal. I kept watch while you were gone. The waste did not sleep while you were gone — blood was spilled and ground changed hands. Read the World for the account."

[2026-08-22T22:43:11.117Z] [player] Ask where he stopped setting traps
[2026-08-22T22:43:11.117Z] [world] "There is a valley north of my stead I pulled every trap out of, three seasons back." Bran refills your cup before he goes on, which is how he buys thinking time. "Something dens there now that keeps ORDER
. No kills inside the valley — anywhere. The boars water beside the hounds, and everything walks in slow." He turns the cup in his hands. "And under the old warren mouth, at dusk, something glints. Metal. Worked metal, down a den no digger made." He meets your eye. "I will not disturb the peace of that valley on curiosity. But you go places I do not. Walk in slow, mind, or do not walk in."
